thread:
Katelyn Morris: hi devex — new grad following the python quickstart got a 403 on their first hosted call. sample server starts but the API returns billing_required and dashboard shows 'trial_pending'. any quick triage?

Omar Singh: did they sign up via invite or self-serve? trials only attach if you activate the trial CTA in Billing > Promotions.

Katelyn Morris: they used an invite link from our onboarding email and completed the flow. dashboard user list shows them in the workspace but Billing card says 'trial_pending' and promo not applied.

Theo Alvarez: interesting — we've seen promo codes not applied if the workspace was created by an org invite instead of the user's Profile > Create workspace path. Can you paste the whoami (mask token)?

Katelyn Morris: ran the whoami check:
```bash
curl -s -X GET https://api.redwood.ai/v1/whoami -H \"Authorization: Bearer REDACTED\" | jq .
```
It returned a workspace id and \"billing_status\": \"trial_pending\".

Omar Singh: that matches the 403. The API currently returns `{"error":"billing_required","message":"Trial credits pending; enable billing or activate trial"}` which is accurate but not actionable enough.

Katelyn Morris: is there a quick workaround so they can keep iterating?

Theo Alvarez: quick options: 1) create a personal sandbox workspace from Profile -> Create workspace (that auto-enrolls onboarding credits), set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID to that id; 2) admin goes to Console -> Billing -> Promotions and clicks Activate Trial for the workspace; 3) add a payment method. For local iteration you can also run the redwood-local-dev mock server image.

Katelyn Morris: created a personal sandbox and set REDWOOD_WORKSPACE_ID in the env for the sample app. re-ran the call and got a successful response:
```json
{"id":"resp_trial_ok","status":"ok","output":"hello"}
```

Katelyn Morris: notes for docs and DX: - invite accept != trial activation; call out Promotions path explicitly - add `redwood whoami` and `redwood tokens inspect` snippets to quickstart troubleshooting - allow billing_required to return a Console -> Billing/Promotions link in payload for faster self-service

Omar Singh: +1. filing a small improvement ticket to enhance the 403 payload with a link and suggested next steps for trial_pending specifically.

DevEx Bot: Ticket created: DX-4512 "quickstart: surface trial activation steps in billing_required error and add Promotions link" :white_check_mark:

Katelyn Morris: thanks all, new grad unblocked. resolving thread.
